What is inside

Everything you need to pass, in one place

Every tool follows the 433A exam blueprint, so your study time goes where the marks are. Your progress stays on this device, with no account and no password.

01

Practice Bay

Drill by section or by book exam. Learn mode explains every answer as you go. Timed mode holds feedback until the end.

  • Sorted by the six exam sections
  • Missed questions go to your Punch List
  • Sets of 10 to 40 questions
02

Mock Exams

Sit the four full-length exams from the book under exam rules, or run the Blueprint Simulator for a fresh paper every time.

  • 135 questions · 4 hours
  • 45-question Quick Mock
  • Score by section
03

Flashcards

500 cards in six decks. Rate yourself and the app picks when you see each card again, from the same session to weeks later.

  • Spaced repetition
  • Missed cards return fast
  • Track the cards you have mastered
04

Trade Calculators

Alignment, rigging, drives, bearings, pumps and more, worked out live. Every tool shows its formula so the maths sticks.

  • 9 working calculators
  • Formula sheet one tap away
  • Built-in calculator
The exam blueprint

Six sections. One blueprint.

The Red Seal exam is scored on six Major Work Activities. The app follows your score in each one and points you at the gaps, weighted the way the real exam is.

Built for the shop floor

Plan your study like a job

Whether you are finishing your apprenticeship, challenging as a trade qualifier, or coming back for another try, the app sets each day's work around your results.

ApprenticeTrade QualifierRetake
  1. Sign in with your nameNo account needed. Your progress saves on this device.
  2. Run the Baseline Inspection30 mixed questions give your starting score for each section.
  3. Work today's ordersDaily jobs target your weakest areas until you reach 70% or better.
